Applying underarm roll-on after shaving is generally safe, but it is important to wait a few minutes after shaving to allow the skin to heal and avoid irritation. Shaving can cause small cuts and abrasions on the skin, increasing the risk of irritation and infection. Applying a roll-on immediately after shaving can also cause stinging or burning sensations, as the skin is more sensitive. To avoid irritation and discomfort, it is recommended to wait at least 10-15 minutes after shaving before applying an underarm roll-on.

faq.question: Why does your hair fall post-pregnancy?

sections.title: How to Use 5 % AHA BHA Exfoliating Bodywash?
sections.content: Step 1 Apply a generous amount of body wash to your palms or loofah. Massage onto wet skin in a circular motion. Step 2 Rinse thoroughly after cleansing. Remember to apply sun protection after exfoliating.

sections.title: Important Information
sections.content: To see a noticeable difference in your skin, it is recommended that you use this 5% AHA BHA Exfoliating Bodywash regularly and consistently for 3-4 months. Patch tests are easy to ensure you don't experience any initial adverse reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test before starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps: 1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow 2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn't a leave-on product) 4. If any redness, itching, or irritation is observed at any time during the test, do not use the product, else you can safely use it

faq.question: What's this product for? What do you mean by dual exfoliation?
faq.answer: This advanced body wash provides dual exfoliation. It uses natural perlite beads (derived from volcanic ash) and encapsulated salicylic acid beads for gentle physical exfoliation, buffing away dead skin cells. The AHA/BHA combination (glycolic and lactic acid/salicylic acid) provides deeper chemical exfoliation, unclogs pores, reduces the appearance of "strawberry skin" and bumps, and promotes cell turnover. Lactic acid also adds a hydrating benefit.

faq.question: I am new to exfoliation; what should I know about this product?
faq.answer: Exfoliation is the way to smoother skin! This body wash uses both AHAs (glycolic and lactic acid) and BHAs (salicylic acid) for gentle exfoliation. If you're new to exfoliating, start by using it 2-3 times a week and gradually increase to daily use as your skin adjusts. Discontinue use if you experience any irritation.

faq.question: Why do I need to use SPF after any AHA-BHA products?
faq.answer: AHAs and BHAs, while incredibly effective can also make your skin more sensitive to the sun. Using a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of 30 or higher every day is crucial to protect your skin from sun damage. Think of it as protecting your newly revealed, radiant skin!

faq.question: Can I use this product on my face?
faq.answer: This product is formulated for use on the body and may be too potent for the delicate skin on your face. We recommend using products specifically designed for facial exfoliation.

faq.question: Won't this product be harsh on my body? Can I use it everyday?
faq.answer: While this product contains powerful exfoliants, it's also formulated with nourishing ingredients like shea butter and oils to help soothe and moisturise the skin. However, everyone's skin is different. We recommend starting with 2-3 uses per week and gradually increasing to daily use as your skin tolerates it. If you experience any redness, dryness, or irritation, reduce usage or discontinue use.

faq.question: How does it help with razor bumps and ingrown hair?
faq.answer: " The glycolic and lactic acids provide deep exfoliation, while salicylic acid (a BHA) helps prevent and treat ingrown hairs and razor bumps. Salicylic acid gently exfoliates the skin's surface and unclogs pores, allowing hairs to grow out properly and reducing redness, inflammation, and bumps. "

faq.question: What are the benefits of this body wash?
faq.answer: This body wash is formulated to address rough, bumpy skin through dual exfoliation while also hydrating and nourishing. It's an excellent solution for body acne, tan reduction, and pigmentation concerns. While providing deep exfoliation, it's also designed to be hydrating and non-drying.

faq.question: Why do I need two different sunscreens for face and body?
faq.answer: Face skin is thinner, acne-prone, and spends more time under makeup  -  it needs a lightweight, non-comedogenic formula. Body skin is thicker and more exposed -it needs a hydrating, tan-correcting formula with a stronger moisture base. Using one for both leaves gaps in protection or causes breakouts.

faq.question: Is SPF 50+ PA++++ enough for daily use?
faq.answer: Yes. SPF 50+ blocks around 98% of UVB rays, and PA++++ is the highest UVA protection rating available - ideal for Indian sun exposure. Reapply every 2-3 hours if you're outdoors.

faq.question: How long before I see the tan reduce?
faq.answer: Tan correction is gradual. With daily use and consistent reapplication, most users notice more even skin tone within a few weeks. Results vary with skin type and sun exposure.

faq.question: Will it leave a white cast?
faq.answer: No. Both formulas are designed for Indian skin tones. The face sunscreen has an aqua-gel texture that disappears in 3 seconds; the body lotion absorbs clean with no ghostly film.

faq.question: Is the face sunscreen safe for acne-prone skin?
faq.answer: Yes- it contains ACZERO, a Korean anti-acne technology that is non-comedogenic and anti-inflammatory, tested safe even on active-acne skin.

faq.question: Is it water and sweat resistant?
faq.answer: The face sunscreen is clinically proven water and sweat resistant up to 80 minutes. The body lotion is non-transferring once absorbed. Reapply after swimming or heavy sweating.

faq.question: Can I wear the face sunscreen under makeup?
faq.answer: Yes. Apply after moisturiser, wait 60 seconds, then proceed with your makeup. It won't pill or ball up.

faq.question: Is this duo suitable for men?
faq.answer: Yes. Both formulas are gender-neutral and built around skin type and skin zone, not gender.

faq.question: Are pimple patches effective?
faq.answer: Hydrocolloid Acne Pimple Patches are a form of spot treatment that works on existing pimples. It is a better alternative than popping your pimples, as these patches don't leave behind scars.

faq.question: When should I apply a pimple patch?
faq.answer: Hydrocolloid Acne Pimple Patches should be used on inflamed acne skin or when you see a pimple showing white or yellow head.

faq.question: Can I use pimple patch everyday?
faq.answer: You can use these patches if you have acne/pimples. They are safe for everyday and all day use.

faq.question: Do pimple patches work on popped pimples?
faq.answer: Yes. If you put a patch over a popped pimple, it will collect the draining pus preventing further infection.

faq.question: Can I shower with pimple patch?
faq.answer: Be Bodywise Hydrocolloid Acne Pimple Patches are water-proof. While it can be used during bathing, we'd recommend removing the patch while washing your face.

faq.question: Do pimple patches leave scars?
faq.answer: Open and popped pimples often leave behind scars. Applying our Hydrocolloid Acne Pimple Patches helps cover up the affected area, preventing picking your acne - thus preventing scarring.

faq.question: What is the white stuff on hydrocolloid patches?
faq.answer: The patch absorbs fluid from the wound, forming a white-gel like substance turning it white. This helps speed up healing and is completely safe for your skin.

faq.question: How long can you wear hydrocolloid patches?
faq.answer: Although the pimples can subside within 48 hours, Be Bodywise Hydrocolloid Acne Pimple Patches are water-proof and make-up friendly and can be worn at a stretch of 3-5 days.

faq.question: Does hydrocolloid work on blackheads?
faq.answer: Be Bodywise Hydrocolloid Acne Pimple Patches work only on surfaced acne and whiteheads. We wouldn't recommend using them for blackheads.

faq.question: Can you put a pimple patch on an ingrown hair?
faq.answer: Be Bodywise Hydrocolloid Acne Pimple Patches work only on surfaced acne and whiteheads. It won't work on ingrown hair.

faq.question: What are the side effects of hydrocolloid?
faq.answer: If you use the patches as instructed and in the areas suggested, it won't cause any side effects.

faq.question: Can pimple patches remove blackheads?
faq.answer: Be Bodywise Hydrocolloid Acne Pimple Patches work only on surfaced acne and whiteheads. We wouldn't recommend using them for blackheads.

faq.question: Can you sleep with pimple patches?
faq.answer: Yes, you can sleep after applying Be Bodywise Hydrocolloid Acne Pimple Patches. The strong adhesive won't come off letting your skin heal overnight.

faq.question: Why do hydrocolloid patches turn white?
faq.answer: The patch absorbs fluid from the wound, forming a white-gel like substance turning it white. This helps speed up healing and is completely safe for your skin.

faq.question: Do hydrocolloid patches work on blind pimples?
faq.answer: Be Bodywise Hydrocolloid Acne Pimple Patches work only on surfaced acne and whiteheads. It won't work on ingrown hair.

faq.question: How to Use Acne Pimple Patch?
faq.answer: Here's how to use an acne pimple patch by Be Bodywise-  Step 1: On cleansed face, cover the active acne with one patch of a suitable size. Step 2: Keep it overnight or a minimum for 6-8 hours and then remove it. Step 3: Repeat the procedure until the acne is completely dry.

faq.question: What is Acne Patch?
faq.answer: An acne patch, also known as a pimple patch or acne sticker, is a small, adhesive patch that is designed to be placed directly on top of a pimple. These patches are typically made of hydrocolloid, a gel-like substance capable of absorbing excess oil and pus from pimples. Acne patches are frequently used as a spot treatment for pimples, especially those that have already popped. They can be worn under makeup and throughout the day, making them a convenient and discreet way to treat pimples.

faq.question: Should I Pop Pimple Before Pimple Patch?
faq.answer: No, It is not recommended to pop a pimple before using a pimple patch. Popping a pimple can increase the risk of infection, inflammation, and scarring and can also make it more difficult for the pimple patch to adhere to the skin.
